## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: 2 drops: NASA Tests 7 and 8 = Bendix drops 20 and 21 (Table 5-T2: NASA Drop No. 7 and 8), SS Loose. soil_no 7 matched by family and state (Table 2-3 SS Loose); T5-3 gamma 96.0 and phi 30 differ from Table 2-3 soil 7 (94.7 pcf, 29 deg). Table 5-T2 prints the same D_r, gamma, phi and nominal V_V, V_H 5, 7 and 10, 0; the repeated SS Loose drops 18 (Bad recording) and 19 (Bad release) print 95.2 pcf. Text 5-44: after each drop the soil was completely removed before a new bed was prepared; no reuse stated. setup_incomplete: footpad diameter and mass not printed in Section V; depth of the loose beds not printed; test gravity not stated (Table 5-T1 scale factors imply 1 g model drops); formula and g used to calculate V_v, V_h from tau not printed
- Codex: Two drops, NASA 7-8, Bendix 20-21. Table 5-T2 gives nominal ft/s. Table 2-3 soil No. 7 is a family-and-state match. Fill depth and numerical test gravity are unspecified. Fresh bed per drop.
